title: Who sold what? The ser passive

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the passive with *ser* + past participle from B1 Unit 18 (*La ley fue aprobada por el Parlamento*), and the *se* passive from B1 Unit 6. The *ser* passive is useful for privatisation, because it puts the company first and can still name who acted with *por*.

items.spanish: La compañía telefónica fue privatizada en 1990.
items.english: The telephone company was privatised in 1990.

items.spanish: Los bancos fueron vendidos a inversores privados.
items.english: The banks were sold to private investors.

items.spanish: Aerolíneas Argentinas fue vendida por el gobierno a un grupo de empresas.
items.english: Aerolíneas Argentinas was sold by the government to a group of companies.

sections.content: The participle agrees with the subject: *privatizada* after *la compañía*, *vendidos* after *los bancos*. *Ser* shows the tense (*fue*, *fueron*). Name the agent with *por* only when it matters; if the agent is general, the *se* passive also works: *se vendieron empresas*.
